How compliance gaps accumulate

A 500-day comparison of manual controls and continuous monitoring.

The model links missed checks, incomplete documentation, and the timing of reviews with estimated audit exposure. It illustrates a mechanism rather than a measured organization.

Scenario assumptions

Team size, daily control volume, and review frequency determine how quickly unresolved gaps accumulate in the model.

Number of employees performing compliance checks.

Total operational controls executed daily, including temperature logs, cleaning checks, and traceability entries.

Formal audits every 125 workdays with light spot reviews between cycles. Drift can build before the next formal review.
